items.caption: The seal-script form of 歲 is analyzed in the transmitted Shuowen as 步 with 戌 as a phonetic element. This later analysis does not settle competing explanations of the early graph.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 歲, with a compact upper section above a larger, complex lower section.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the later form associated with the transmitted component analysis, while keeping that account distinct from disputed explanations of the early graph.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not an ancient artifact image. Early graphic explanations remain disputed, and this seal-script form cannot establish the character’s original construction.
